authority.rule: All scientific metrics, denominators, support boundaries, truth admissibility rules, result classification, one-shot consumption semantics, and claim boundaries are inherited exactly from the frozen D0 constitution. This protocol may add only stricter pre-exposure orchestration and provenance guards; it may not relax, replace, reinterpret, or override D0.

authorization_state_machine.heldout_open_condition: A separately containing authority commit must freeze PREHELDOUT_ARM_RECEIPT_PASS proving the isolated implementation is exact, the semantic snapshot is exact, all frozen evaluator/baseline/ablation identities are exact, credential/runtime readiness is exact, and every protected-read/execution counter remains zero.
this_commit_authorizes: materialize an isolated Gate2E implementation from this containing commit as sole parent
run exact preheldout readiness preflight that reads no Epistemic-10 input, truth, operator, stratum, or fresh-target bytes
freeze a preheldout arm receipt on authority
this_commit_does_not_authorize: Gate2E full-system semantic execution on Epistemic-10
baseline or ablation semantic execution on Epistemic-10

additional_stricter_orchestration_guards: Before any protected access, require PREHELDOUT_ARM_RECEIPT_PASS frozen on authority.
After opaque staging and before semantic execution, freeze a staging receipt containing only count, locators, hashes, byte counts, and exposure counters.
Execute full RISU twice under the exact frozen semantic snapshot and require logical byte identity.
Execute all preregistered applicable baselines and all three frozen ablations before truth access.
Run independent checkers and freeze all pre-truth machine outputs before any truth unlock.
Upload and content-address a pre-truth machine artifact before truth unlock.
Only then unlock preexisting independently authored truth/gold metadata and join by the frozen opaque identity relation.
Run the frozen Gate2D evaluator and independent checker twice and require logical byte identity.
Upload the complete final result artifact before asserting or interpreting PASS/FAIL.
Freeze the first-complete or first-consumed failure immutably on authority before inspecting semantic outcome patterns or diagnosing failures.

frozen_non_b3_evaluation_identity.rule: The D1primeprime supersession changes only the prospectively qualified B3 Copilot panel identity. Every other evaluator, checker, baseline, ablation, applicability, mapping, and metric identity remains governed by the frozen D0/D1/D2 lineage and must be reverified by content address before any heldout access.

gate2d_exit_evidence.interpretation: D1primeprime froze the currently executable Terra/Sonnet Copilot identities; D2primeprime requalified the exact preregistered 30-case evaluator challenge under those identities; D3primeprime then passed the nonheldout transport/response-shape smoke and was immutably frozen before semantic outcome inspection. Together these satisfy the D0 requirement that Gate2E may open only after a passing D3 closure, subject to this protocol's stricter arming gate.

heldout_staging_contract.opaque_staging_retry_rule: Allowed only under the D0 OPAQUE_STAGING_ONLY_NOT_CONSUMED state and only for orchestration changes after an explicit nonconsumption receipt.

scientifically_consumed_if_any: any full-system semantic execution on heldout
any baseline semantic execution on heldout
any ablation semantic execution on heldout

preheldout_arm_receipt_required_checks: authority parent and this protocol Git blob exact
semantic snapshot commit and every D0 critical semantic/C1 blob exact
Terra/Sonnet config, prompt, schema, runner, CLI package/version, model identifiers, retry policy, and tool denial exact
heldout source locator resolution has not been attempted
credential value absent from repository, logs, and artifacts
scientific_question: Can the one-shot sealed Epistemic-10 be executed exactly once under the fully frozen RISU semantic snapshot, evaluator, independent checker, Terra/Sonnet frontier baselines, other preregistered baselines, and ablations, with machine outputs frozen before truth join and with no post-hoc change to metrics, support, selection, or interpretation?
